source.path: /Volumes/元宇宙联合创新实验室/实验数据/MatrAIx多地区选品源数据/06_历史北美电商/origin-original.tab
source.note: Byte-identical to the authors' final_w1w2.tab in the Dataverse archive.

resolved.age: stored as (age - 17); the authors add 17 in Appendix.R before banding
resolved.education: q22_w1 (1-7) is the education instrument; the educ column is a different, coarser code
resolved.income: inc 1-11 folded into four published bands; code 5 is captured by the 30-59k branch because the authors' case_when tests that range first
resolved.gender: 1 Male, 2 Female, 3 Other, missing treated as Other by the authors
resolved.timing: Wave 1 (April 2020) held the attitudes; wave 2 (June 2020) held the conjoint, so attitudes are strictly pre-choice.

unresolved: The six attitude items are known only as appendix prose. Without the instrument screenshot, the text cannot be tied to q11_1..q11_6: exactly one four-item combination reproduces the published scale, and its sign pattern does not match the appendix ordering.
Column-to-wording order may have been randomised at administration; guessing would mislabel facts.
consequence: No extra measured facts can be produced without inventing wording, so this study stays out of the stage-2 screen. It is not swapped for a different dataset.
next_source_needed: The article's online appendix Figure A1 (survey instrument screenshot) or the preregistered questionnaire at https://osf.io/dnujq.
